claim: In US NAICS 711500 (Independent Artists, Writers, and Performers) in May 2022, payroll employment was 61,710 with a median hourly wage of $24.58 against a mean hourly wage of $35.75, a 1.45x mean-to-median ratio indicating strong right skew even within the payrolled minority.
stance_target: The position that creative-occupation earnings are right-skewed even in administrative payroll data, so mean-based figures overstate typical earnings
scope_conditions: United States only; May 2022 reference period; BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, collected from employers of all sizes in every state and DC; employment RSE 0.1%, mean-wage RSE 17.1%

claim: BLS OEWS counts only 61,710 workers in the independent-artists industry because the survey is collected from employers and therefore excludes the self-employed, against roughly 172,000 people the ACS records in the same industry group.
stance_target: The use of BLS payroll wage statistics as a measure of independent creator or artist earnings
scope_conditions: United States only; May 2022 OEWS versus 2024 ACS-based Data USA count of 172,376; the discrepancy is definitional, not temporal, since NEA/ACS shows 34-57 percent self-employment across artist occupations
quoted_support: These national industry-specific occupational employment and wage estimates are calculated with data collected from employers of all sizes, in metropolitan and nonmetropolitan areas in every state and the District of Columbia

claim: Within the independent-artists industry the spread across creative sub-occupations is roughly three-to-one, from craft artists at a $17.00 median hourly wage and $37,070 annual mean to producers and directors at $47.69 median hourly and $116,290 annual mean.
stance_target: The position that 'creator' or 'artist' is not a single income class and aggregate creative-occupation averages conceal order-of-magnitude craft-level differences
scope_conditions: United States only; May 2022 OEWS within NAICS 711500; wage-and-salary workers only; several detail rows suppressed for small cells
numbers: $39.82 special effects artists and animators median
